anomaly_detection.undefined_denominator_: null when a denominator is zero
metric_denominators.onboarding_completio: completed onboarding cases / all onboarding cases
metric_denominators.average_onboarding_c: mean completed_at minus opened_at, in days, over completed cases
metric_denominators.overdue_task_rate: overdue or unfinished past-due tasks / all tasks (fixed reporting cutoff 2027-01-01 UTC)
metric_denominators.asset_recovery_compl: returned historical asset assignments for terminated employees / all historical asset assignments for terminated employees
metric_denominators.offboarding_completi: completed offboarding cases / all offboarding cases
metric_denominators.audit_coverage_rate: completed tasks, onboarding cases, and offboarding cases with an entity audit event / all completed tasks and cases
